data.exact_reserve_text: During 2017 we released prior year reserves of $176.9m (2016: $180.2m). Our specialty lines division increased reserve releases as the post recession portfolio from 2012 onwards matures. Specialty lines releases also included amounts from the 2014/2015 cyber portfolio, an area that has more variability than the rest of the specialty lines account. This counter-balanced lower releases on short tail classes where the mechanical effect of reduced margins on reserve releases, along with the effects of a large series of natural disasters, is now visable. data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate released $176.9m of prior year reserves in 2017. Releases were driven largely by specialty lines as post-recession portfolios from 2012 onwards matured and included releases from the 2014/2015 cyber portfolio. These releases were partially offset by reduced releases on short-tail classes due to reduced margins and by the impact of a series of 2017 natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, Mexican earthquakes and Californian wildfires). The net effect was a material prior-year release shown by division in the report.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding 2016 column). Prior year development taken from Managing Agent strategic narrative: explicit statement 'During 2017 we released prior year reserves of $176.9m' and the per-division table. Amounts are reported in the accounts' functional currency (USD). A gross claims development triangle is present in the Technical Provisions note but OCR of percentage rows contains some alignment/column uncertainties; triangle was used for cross-checking only. The $176.9m figure is presented in narrative as 'released' (treated as gross release). Field names contain 'gbp' but amounts are in the report currency (USD).
